lines.text: Wh-why are you staring at me like that?
Move over, will ya? I'm bored stiff just standing here.
I-I didn't come here for you.

If-If you want to see it, take a look!
But I've got my eyes on you.

I told you, I don't like sugary coffee or anything like that!
Really!

I-I'm not here to see you! 
And I'm not here because I miss you either!
How long is the Commander going to keep me waiting? I have better things to do...

You're feeling under the weather? Well... I-I could care less!
Hey, you're not moving too much, are you okay?
The Courthouse here is so... ha...
If anyone is giving you a hard time, come to the Courthouse and I'll straighten everything out.
At least the coffee here isn't half bad.
If you want to be with me, I'll make an exception.
Hmmm, not bad.
Good job.
I'll make an exception and give you some praise.
Fine, I'll accept it just this once.
Did I say that I like this? Are you sure...
I must admit, I'm... happy. But only a bit!
Wh-who said I was falling for you? Don't be ridiculous!

I am into you? Wh-who said that?
You're the one who has a crush on me!
I like you more... just a little bit.
Need me?
Any instructions?
Understood.
Enemy sighted!
Get 'em!
Don't worry, I'll handle it.
Here we go.
Reload.
Don't worry.
One more time.
My turn!
Target locked, commence bombardment!
Faster! Stronger! Keep shooting!
Neutralized.
I could do this in my sleep.
Easy as pie.
Ahh!
Errrrr!
Ah!
Is this the end? It... can't be...
Victory! With me on your team, did you expect anything else?
Did everyone finish their homework? Anyone who didn't will be required to join me for a special lesson later.
Focus on class if you don't want to get in trouble.
Today's lesson will be included on the exam.
D-don't stare at me! Eyes on the blackboard!
We'll have our special lesson... after school.
S-stories about my first love? I-I-I don't have any...!
The bell is about to ring. If you have nothing to say, may I go get ready for class?
L-let's see how far we can get in today's lesson...
It'd be nice to have a school out here.
Whether you're a teacher or a student, proper rest is important.
The library has lots of valuable materials that can help you in class.
Class is starting now. Everyone to your seats.
I was already smart, of course, but now I feel even smarter.
Today's class is going to be perfect.
I bet the students will respect me now.
Y-you can try to bribe me, but it won't make the test any easier.
As a teacher, I can't accept such a gift. ... Wait! J-just kidding! Please give it back!
This will look great in the teacher's office. Thank you.
D-don't you think we're moving a little fast?
I-I've never read about this feeling in a textbook!
Wh-what do you mean, "What's the definition of love?" Why would you ask me that?!
I'll take charge here.
You called?
Try to keep up.
Prepare for combat!
Let me show you how it's done.
This isn't a drill. Get ready.
Do just as I taught you.
Am I moving too fast?
Wait just a moment.
I need a brief rest.
Watch carefully, everyone.
You dare sleep during my class?!
Focus, everyone!
Who's next?
Did you see that?
See? Easy!
Ugh!
Agh!
Ouch!
I didn't want to... have to teach you failure...
Class is dismissed. Good job, everyone.
